sql_exec.name: sql_exec
sql_exec.description:
Run one agent-written read-only analytical query over the warehouse.

The query must be a single SELECT or WITH statement over the declared
silver tables. Writes, stacked statements, and tables outside the
declared set are refused before execution. Results are capped at
RERUN_ROW_CAP rows with a RERUN_TIMEOUT_S statement timeout; a valid
query returning 0 rows returns ok=True, rows=[], row_count=0, and
meta.empty_observation=True (unless DIME_STRICT_NONEMPTY_SQL=1).
Name the primary numeric column for what it measures, so a percentage
answers as TS_PCT and a count as `n`; the column you alias is the
column a citation binds to.

Every ok result also carries meta.basis and meta.profile. If you need
a contributor count for an expression such as AVG, or distinct-value
counts, add COUNT(metric) or COUNT(DISTINCT x) columns to your query.

warehouse_schema.name: warehouse_schema
warehouse_schema.description: Read declared warehouse columns, source units and season encodings. Pass tables to return only those declared tables (avoiding full catalog payloads). Declared table allowlist: silver_advanced, silver_bbref_awards, silver_boxscores, silver_cap_players, silver_cap_room, silver_clutch, silver_combine, silver_contracts, silver_four_factors, silver_four_factors_team, silver_free_agents, silver_hist_draft, silver_hist_gamelogs, silver_hist_lineups, silver_hist_player_seasons, silver_hist_possessions, silver_hist_shots, silver_hist_standings, silver_hist_team_seasons, silver_hustle_player, silver_hustle_team, silver_impact, silver_injuries, silver_injury_entries, silver_leaders_ast, silver_leaders_blk, silver_leaders_pts, silver_leaders_reb, silver_leaders_stl, silver_lineups, silver_news, silver_on_off, silver_player_gamelogs, silver_player_season, silver_playoff_gamelogs, silver_playoffs, silver_preseason_projections, silver_rapm, silver_rapm_prior, silver_raptor_player, silver_raptor_team, silver_rosters, silver_salaries, silver_schedule, silver_shots, silver_standings, silver_stints, silver_team_games, silver_team_ratings, silver_transactions. This allowlist names declared tables, not proof of actual table content, complete warehouse inventory or data freshness. catalog_scope covers the returned declared tables and columns only, not the full warehouse inventory; a name absent here is not evidence it is absent everywhere.

args_schema.description: Read declared warehouse columns, source units and season encodings.
args_schema.title: warehouse_schema

get_rapm.name: get_rapm
get_rapm.description: RAPM-lite ratings. Blank player returns top list, else one row.

One row per metric covering the season; rank is 1..N by value within that season's player pool. Player required; season optional. Warehouse only; each row cites its source.

get_game_prediction.description: Pre-game Monte Carlo prediction: win probability, projected score/total, and confidence intervals. Model estimates with documented methodology, not betting picks. Two team names/abbrevs/ids; optional game_date (MM/DD/YYYY), n_sims, seed for reproducibility.

get_wpa_leaders.name: get_wpa_leaders

WPA-by-play leaderboard for one season. Season is an end-year clamped to 2021..2025.

Deltas come from the fitted win-probability model before and after
each play, credited to the acting player. Documented estimates.

args_schema.description: WPA-by-play leaderboard for one season.
args_schema.title: get_wpa_leaders

get_comps.name: get_comps

args_schema.description: Nearest statistical neighbors by per-36 + advanced shape. Same-season only.
args_schema.title: get_comps

get_lineup_stats.name: get_lineup_stats
get_lineup_stats.description:
Five-man lineup ratings with sample floors. Names, abbrevs, or ids.

Units under min_possessions (default 100) are hidden; blowout-heavy
units are flagged. Ratings are per 100 possessions, warehouse-first.
The best lineup (highest NET_RATING among units meeting the floor) is
returned in the top-level best_net_unit field and flagged per-row as
is_best_net_unit, so it is never the most-used unit by default. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Five-man lineup ratings with sample floors. Names, abbrevs, or ids.
args_schema.title: get_lineup_stats

get_win_prob.name: get_win_prob
get_win_prob.description: Real ELO win probability between two abbreviations. Neutral unless home_abbrev matches a side.

args_schema.description: Real ELO win probability between two abbreviations. Neutral unless home_abbrev matches a side.
args_schema.title: get_win_prob

get_on_off.name: get_on_off
get_on_off.description: On and off splits for one player on one team. Possession level. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: On and off splits for one player on one team. Possession level.
args_schema.title: get_on_off

get_shot_zones.name: get_shot_zones
get_shot_zones.description:
Zone splits for one player id: rim, midrange, three with shares.

Warehouse-first: historical silver_hist_shots geometric zones, then
seeded silver_shots, then seeded silver_zone_splits
(basketball-reference distance buckets, league-wide), then live
shot_chart (fail-fast; endpoint-blocked from datacenter IPs).
Zones below min_attempts (default 50, clamped 10..200) are excluded. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Zone splits for one player id: rim, midrange, three with shares.
args_schema.title: get_shot_zones

get_four_factors.name: get_four_factors
get_four_factors.description:
Team four factors (eFG%, TOV%, ORB%, FT rate, plus defensive
mirrors), computed offline from warehouse team game rows. Use for
"why are the Thunder good", "team identity", or any four-factors
ask. Pass a team name/abbrev to scope to one team; empty returns
the full 30-team board.

args_schema.description: Team four factors breakdown (eFG%, TOV%, ORB%, FT rate, plus defensive mirrors).
args_schema.title: get_four_factors

get_clutch_stats.name: get_clutch_stats
get_clutch_stats.description: Clutch stats (last 5 min, margin 5 or less), player or team scope. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: NBA clutch statistics (last 5 min, margin <= 5) for player or team scope.
args_schema.title: get_clutch_stats

get_competitive_ratings.name: get_competitive_ratings
get_competitive_ratings.description:
Competitive MOV: what happens to a team's MOV when blowouts are dropped.

team: 3-letter abbrev, full name, nickname, city, or "league"/"" for
all teams. season: "YYYY-YY" or "all" for every warehouse season
(multi-season output is pooled across seasons, not a single
team-season -- see meta.season_note). season_type: regular (default),
playoffs, or all; matched against the actual distinct warehouse values
before aggregating. NOTE: the default changed from "all" to "regular"
on 2026-09-10 so season-scoped queries no longer silently mix playoff
games in; pass "all" explicitly to include playoffs.
blowout_margin: games with abs(plus_minus) above this are excluded from
the competitive set (clamped to [1, 40]). min_games: floor on
competitive games; rows below it are flagged low_sample and carry
numbers with no interpretation. Warehouse only; plus_minus is each
team's own MOV per game.

args_schema.description: Competitive Margin of Victory (MOV excluding blowouts).
args_schema.title: get_competitive_ratings

get_hustle.name: get_hustle
get_hustle.description: Hustle leaders, player or team scope. Contests, deflections, charges. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: NBA hustle leaders for player or team scope.
args_schema.title: get_hustle

get_injuries.name: get_injuries
get_injuries.description:
Injury report, optional team abbreviation or player filter.

With a player name, also joins playoff inactive listings so
'is X injured?' surfaces 'inactive for the entire playoff run'
instead of a bare 'active' (F45). Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: NBA injury and availability report.
args_schema.title: get_injuries

get_news_feed.name: get_news_feed
get_news_feed.description: Recent NBA news items from warehouse-seeded RSS feeds (headline, published, url, players/teams mentioned). Optional team abbreviation or player-name filter. Reads the warehouse only; refresh with seed_injury_news.py.

get_award_results.name: get_award_results
get_award_results.description:
Recorded NBA award results read from published ballots.

view=winner returns every subject sharing the leading rank for one award in
one season. view=winner_history returns the leading-rank subject(s) for that
award in every covered season through the requested season. view=field returns
the whole ranked ballot with vote shares and vote counts. view=player_awards
returns one player's award record through the named season. Use get_award_race
for a model score, never for a result.

args_schema.description: Historical recorded NBA award voting results.
args_schema.title: get_award_results

get_briefing.name: get_briefing
get_briefing.description: Morning briefing: scoreboard plus top scorers. Date MM/DD/YYYY, blank means latest. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Morning briefing: scoreboard plus top scorers. Date MM/DD/YYYY, blank means latest.
args_schema.title: get_briefing

get_standings.name: get_standings
get_standings.description: League standings for one season like 2025-26. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: NBA regular-season conference and league standings for any season.
args_schema.title: get_standings

get_rest.name: get_rest
get_rest.description: Back-to-back plus rest-day splits from history game dates.

args_schema.description: Back-to-back and rest-day schedule splits for any team.
args_schema.title: get_rest

get_team_trajectory.name: get_team_trajectory
get_team_trajectory.description:
Multi-season regular-season records for one team, newest first.

This is a trajectory evidence primitive, not a trend opinion. It reads
complete historical standings and returns record and win percentage for
a bounded number of seasons ending at through_season.

args_schema.description: Multi-season regular-season records and win percentages for any team.
args_schema.title: get_team_trajectory

get_ratings.name: get_ratings
get_ratings.description:
Team ratings, optionally bound to one requested ranked metric.

When ``requested_metric`` and ``ranking_direction`` are set, rows are
ordered by that metric field and the payload owns the leader claim.
``team`` narrows a direct team-ratings question. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Team offensive, defensive, net ratings, and pace (league-wide or team specific).
args_schema.title: get_ratings

get_rookie_leaders.name: get_rookie_leaders
get_rookie_leaders.description:
Current rookie class leaderboard (first-year NBA players only).

Rookies are defined structurally: a player in the current-season
stats table with NO row in any prior season (hist or warehouse).
Never an age proxy, never historical seasons (F46: a "rookies 20+
ppg" query answered from 2023-24 listed Edwards/LaMelo/Wemby; the
right answer was the current draft class, e.g. Cooper Flagg).
stat is a per-game column: ppg, rpg, apg, spg, bpg, mpg.

args_schema.description: Current rookie class leaderboard (first-year NBA players only, verified against historical seasons).
args_schema.title: get_rookie_leaders

get_cap_ledger.name: get_cap_ledger
get_cap_ledger.description: Payroll plus apron room for one abbreviation. 2026-27 thresholds.

args_schema.description: Payroll, luxury tax position, and first/second apron room for one team.
args_schema.title: get_cap_ledger

get_leaders.name: get_leaders
get_leaders.description:
Qualified league leaderboard for one stat category.

ranking_direction is ``desc`` for highest-first or ``asc`` for
lowest-first. min_attempts carries an explicit user volume floor for
percentage metrics; zero keeps the league qualification.

Percentage boards use the NBA minimums carried by the warehouse
instead of an arbitrary attempts floor. For 3P%, the qualification is
82 made threes over an 82-game season. This keeps the board comparable
to the official league leaderboard and excludes tiny samples. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Qualified league statistical leaders for any category.
args_schema.title: get_leaders

get_lineup_leaders.name: get_lineup_leaders
get_lineup_leaders.description:
League-wide five-man lineup net-rating leaderboard.

Net rating is PLUS_MINUS per 48 minutes from the warehouse lineup
table. A minimum-minutes floor (default 100) is ALWAYS applied and
stated: a +3 in 4 minutes is a 300.0 'net rating' on a junk slice
and never tops the board (F50).

args_schema.description: League-wide 5-man lineup net-rating leaderboard with minutes qualification floor.
args_schema.title: get_lineup_leaders

get_playoffs.name: get_playoffs
get_playoffs.description: Playoff wins per team plus champion for one season. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Playoff series wins per team, finals matchup, and champion for any season.
args_schema.title: get_playoffs

get_team_leaders.name: get_team_leaders
get_team_leaders.description:
Team totals leaderboard for a counting stat (PTS, REB, AST, STL,
BLK): player game logs summed by team, with per-game averages.
Use for "which team leads in total assists" - get_leaders is
player-level only.

args_schema.description: Team totals leaderboard for a counting stat (PTS, REB, AST, STL, BLK).
args_schema.title: get_team_leaders

get_team_compare.name: get_team_compare
get_team_compare.description:
Top-N team compare on one counting stat: total, per-game, games
played, and the win-loss record joined from standings, in one
board. Use for multi-metric team compares ("compare the top 3
scoring teams: totals, per-game, and wins") - get_team_leaders has
no records and a delegate fan-out composes nameless tables with
empty cells or invented numbers (F66). The answer is built
deterministically from the rows into meta.deterministic_answer;
compose ships it verbatim (v67 design law).

args_schema.description: Top-N team comparison on a counting stat joined with win-loss records.
args_schema.title: get_team_compare

get_elo_standings.name: get_elo_standings
get_elo_standings.description: ELO power ratings as standings: implied win pct, win equivalents, and Elo-implied spreads. ROADMAP Appendix #3.

args_schema.description: ELO power ratings as standings with implied win pct, win equivalents, and Elo-implied spreads.
args_schema.title: get_elo_standings

get_draft_board.name: get_draft_board
get_draft_board.description: Draft board: college production plus combine measurements, blended rank. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Blended draft board rankings combining college production and combine testing.
args_schema.title: get_draft_board

get_combine.name: get_combine
get_combine.description: Draft combine measurements plus shooting drills for one draft year. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Anthropometric measurements (height, wingspan, reach, weight) and athletic drills.
args_schema.title: get_combine

get_young_player_usage.name: get_young_player_usage
get_young_player_usage.description:
Qualified usage-rate board for young players from silver_advanced.

Uses total minutes (GP * per-game MIN) as the sample floor. The default
means age 22 or younger with at least 1,000 minutes in the asked season.
A hard 500-total-minute floor is ALWAYS enforced: the caller may raise
it but never undercut it.

args_schema.description: Usage-rate leaderboard for young players with customizable age ceilings and minute floors.
args_schema.title: get_young_player_usage

get_contract_value.name: get_contract_value
get_contract_value.description:
Contract value residuals from production vs salary.

Returns league leaders by default; pass team for one roster or player for
one named player's modeled salary and residual.

args_schema.description: Contract value residuals from production vs salary.
args_schema.title: get_contract_value

get_trade_check.name: get_trade_check
get_trade_check.description:
Trade legality check. Player names comma separated per side.

Simplified 2023 CBA: 125 percent plus 250k matching below the first
apron, 100 percent above it, no aggregation above the second apron.
Picks and exceptions stay out of v1.

args_schema.description: CBA trade legality check under 2023 CBA apron and salary matching rules.
args_schema.title: get_trade_check

get_trade_value.name: get_trade_value
get_trade_value.description:
Trade value grade: estimated production value vs salary per side, plus picks.

Reasoning layer on top of get_trade_check (which covers cap legality).
All dollar figures are rough estimates from 2025-26 production versus
2026-27 salaries. Picks like "2029 FRP" or "2030 FRP top-4 protected".

args_schema.description: Trade value grade: estimated production surplus value vs salary per side plus pick equity.
args_schema.title: get_trade_value

get_trade_partners.name: get_trade_partners
get_trade_partners.description: Find CBA-legal salary-matching trade packages for one player across the league. Player name; season defaults to 2026-27; teams optionally restricts partners (comma-separated abbreviations); max_packages caps rows per team (default 3). Each row is a roster package (up to 3 players) whose salary satisfies both sides' matching rules under the same simplified 2023 CBA as get_trade_check.

get_situational_splits.name: get_situational_splits
get_situational_splits.description: Clutch situational splits for one player or team: score state plus venue.

args_schema.description: Clutch situational splits for one player or team across score margins, time thresholds, and venues.
args_schema.title: get_situational_splits

get_playoff_sim.name: get_playoff_sim
get_playoff_sim.description: Simulated title and finals odds from ratings, Monte Carlo brackets. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

get_player_risers.name: get_player_risers
get_player_risers.description:

player's own season average, warehouse only. Use this for
player-level 'who is rising/falling/hot' asks; get_risers is the
TEAM version (win-rate windows).

args_schema.description: Player risers and fallers: last-N games scoring and efficiency versus season baseline.
args_schema.title: get_player_risers

get_standings_deep.name: get_standings_deep
get_standings_deep.description: Standings deep cuts: clutch records, comeback kings, blown leads, monthly momentum.

args_schema.description: Standings deep cuts: clutch records, comeback kings, blown leads, and monthly momentum.
args_schema.title: get_standings_deep

get_warehouse_freshness.name: get_warehouse_freshness
get_warehouse_freshness.description: Warehouse freshness panel: every silver table, row count, last fetch, stale flag.

args_schema.description: Warehouse freshness and data recency panel across all silver tables.
args_schema.title: get_warehouse_freshness

get_finder.description:
Team finder across history seasons. Modes: streak, versus, span,

args_schema.description: Historical multi-season search across streaks, versus, span, player_streak, and head2head.
args_schema.title: get_finder

get_draft_model.name: get_draft_model
get_draft_model.description: Star-probability classifier from college production (honest proxy). Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Prospect star-probability classifier from college production.
args_schema.title: get_draft_model

get_leaderboard_deltas.name: get_leaderboard_deltas
get_leaderboard_deltas.description: Scoring leaderboard movers: latest snapshot vs the one from days ago.

args_schema.description: Scoring leaderboard movers: latest snapshot vs the one from days ago.
args_schema.title: get_leaderboard_deltas

get_player_ratings.name: get_player_ratings
get_player_ratings.description:
Qualified player on-court offensive or defensive rating leaderboard.

These are lineup results while the player was on court, not an individual
defensive-value metric. A hard 500-total-minute floor is ALWAYS enforced:
the caller cannot undercut it, so garbage-time players can never top the
board (a 0-minute floor once crowned a 53.3 on-court DEF_RATING from
~15 total minutes as the "best defensive player").

args_schema.description: Qualified player on-court offensive or defensive rating leaderboard.
args_schema.title: get_player_ratings

get_risers.name: get_risers
get_risers.description: Risers and fallers: last-N win pct vs season win pct, warehouse only.

args_schema.description: Team risers and fallers: last-N weeks win percentage versus season win percentage.
args_schema.title: get_risers

get_team_four_factors.name: get_team_four_factors
get_team_four_factors.description:
Team four factors (eFG%, TOV%, ORB%, FT rate, plus defensive
mirrors), computed offline from warehouse team game rows. Use for
"why are the Thunder good", "team identity", or any four-factors
ask. Pass a team name/abbrev to scope to one team; empty returns
the full 30-team board.

args_schema.description: Full-board or team-specific Four Factors (eFG%, TOV%, ORB%, FT rate, and defensive mirrors).
args_schema.title: get_team_four_factors

get_streaks.name: get_streaks
get_streaks.description:
Longest or currently-active streaks, ranked league-wide.

stat: points/rebounds/assists/threes/steals/blocks/double-doubles/
triple-doubles, or wins/losses for team scope. threshold: minimum per
game (defaults: 30 pts, 10 reb/ast, 4 threes, 3 stl/blk; ignored for
double-doubles, triple-doubles, wins, losses). scope: player or team.
mode: longest or active. Warehouse only; active means the streak
includes the holder's latest game on record.

args_schema.description: Longest or currently-active streaks, ranked league-wide.
args_schema.title: get_streaks

get_playtype_profile.name: get_playtype_profile
get_playtype_profile.description: Synergy play-type profile for one player or team and season: frequency share, PPP, and percentile per play type on offense or defense. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Synergy play-type profile for one player or team and season: frequency share, PPP, and percentile.
args_schema.title: get_playtype_profile

get_defensive_matchups.name: get_defensive_matchups
get_defensive_matchups.description: One defender's defended-shot profile: frequency and shooter results.

args_schema.description: One defender's defended-shot profile: frequency and shooter results.
args_schema.title: get_defensive_matchups

get_head_to_head.name: get_head_to_head
get_head_to_head.description:
How a player has done against one opponent team.

player: name, nickname, or id (same resolution as every other tool).
opponent: team name, abbreviation, or id, e.g. "Knicks" or "NYK".
season: 2025-26 only in the warehouse; other seasons clamp.

Returns the player's game logs against the opponent (most recent
first), vs-opponent averages next to the season baseline, the deltas
between them, and the player's team record in those games. Fewer
than 5 games sets small_sample and says so plainly. Warehouse only;
player-vs-player is not supported.
If `opponent` names a PLAYER (e.g. "Shai Gilgeous-Alexander"), it
resolves to that player's current team so the lane still answers the
meetings between the two players' teams instead of erroring; the
resolution is disclosed in the note.

args_schema.description: Player matchup history vs one opponent team or opposing player's team.
args_schema.title: get_head_to_head

get_lineup_matchup_matrix.name: get_lineup_matchup_matrix
get_lineup_matchup_matrix.description:
Lineup-vs-lineup matrix for a team matchup. Names, abbrevs, or ids.

Crosses every qualifying 5-man unit of team A against every qualifying
unit of team B over their shared play-level possessions: shared minutes,
net rating in those minutes, sample-size flags. Lineups qualify at
min_minutes season minutes (poss/2); shared minutes are estimated from
possessions (~2 per minute), never play-clock minutes. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Lineup-vs-lineup matrix for a team matchup crossing qualifying 5-man units.
args_schema.title: get_lineup_matchup_matrix

get_transactions.name: get_transactions
get_transactions.description: Team transactions: signings, waivers, trades by team and date range.

args_schema.description: Team front-office transactions: signings, waivers, trades, and conversions.
args_schema.title: get_transactions

With-or-without-you (WOWY) 4-way lineup combination splits for two players.

Accepts player_a and player_b by name or id, or comma-separated player_ids.
Computes Both ON, A ON / B OFF, B ON / A OFF, and Both OFF with minutes,
offensive rating, defensive rating, and net rating from warehouse lineups. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: With-or-without-you (WOWY) 4-way lineup combination splits for two players.
args_schema.title: get_wowy

get_shot_compare.name: get_shot_compare
get_shot_compare.description:
Shot-diet showdown: zone eFG and share for two players.

Missing zone data stays null, never 0.0: a player without a seeded
zone row has NO data there, not a 0% shooter. Edges and the verdict
are computed only where BOTH players have data; takeaways must never
be built on a missing cell. Warehouse-backed with live fallback.

args_schema.description: Shot-diet showdown: zone eFG and share for two players.
args_schema.title: get_shot_compare

get_raptor_history.name: get_raptor_history
get_raptor_history.description: Season-by-season RAPTOR and WAR for one player name. Warehouse only.

args_schema.description: Season-by-season RAPTOR and WAR for one player name.
args_schema.title: get_raptor_history

Head-to-head between two TEAMS: every meeting this season, regular
season and playoffs, with winner and scores when tracked. Use for
"how did X do against Y", "X vs Y record", "season series".

args_schema.description: Head-to-head between two teams across a season: every meeting (regular season and playoffs) with winner, scores, date, matchup.
args_schema.title: get_season_series

get_team_game_log.name: get_team_game_log
get_team_game_log.description:
A team's recent games, most recent first: date, matchup, W/L,
team and opponent points, plus team REB/AST/STL/BLK/TOV. Use for
"show me the <team> last N games" asks - this is the TEAM game log,
never search_game_logs (that tool is per-player and its team_wide
mode returns match counts, not games). team: name, nickname,
abbreviation, or id. limit: 1-30. playoffs: read silver_playoffs

search_shots.description:
Conversational shot finder: filter warehouse shots by player, team,
zone, period, makes, and late-clock window, with zone/period aggregates
plus optional per-player/per-team leaderboards.

zones: rim, short_mid, long_mid, corner_3, atb_3 (comma-separated;
"" = all). periods: 1-4, ot, 1h, 2h, 4th (comma-separated; "" = all).
late_clock: integer seconds remaining (periods 4+, time-based only, not
score-aware). group_by: "" | "player" | "team" -- per-player/per-team
volume + efficiency leaderboards sorted by attempts (this is how you
answer "who takes over fourth quarters"). include_ot: auto (default --
overtime is included when a 4th-quarter/2nd-half window is selected,
when overtime is explicitly selected (periods='ot'), or when late_clock
is given without an explicit period filter), yes, no.
periods='4th' includes overtime by default; pass include_ot=no to get
exactly the 4th quarter. Zero matches return ok True with empty
aggregates and an explanatory note, never silent zeros. Results are
time-based only, never score-aware (meta.clutch_safe=false); TS% is not
shown because the table has no free-throw attempts.

args_schema.description: Conversational shot finder: filter warehouse shots by player, team, zone, period, makes, and late-clock window with zone and period aggregates.

get_rest_advantage.name: get_rest_advantage

Rest advantage: who had the fresher legs before each game.

team: 3-letter abbrev, full team name, or "league"/"" for all 30
teams. season_type: regular, playoffs, or all (default). Games are
filtered to the season_type BEFORE rest gaps are computed, so rest
never leaks across the filter boundary. Warehouse only; the first
game in scope has no rest baseline and reports None.
date: optional YYYY-MM-DD; team mode only. With date and no
opponent, returns the team's single game on that date (summary
still covers the full season as quotable context). opponent:
optional second team; team mode only. Team + opponent + date
returns the completed matchup on that date when one exists, else a
pre-tip-off preview projecting each side's rest from its last
completed game before that date (preview mode: not a warehouse
game record). Team + opponent with no date returns their most
recent completed matchup.

args_schema.description: Rest advantage: who had the fresher legs before each game.
args_schema.title: get_rest_advantage

search_game_logs.name: search_game_logs
search_game_logs.description:
Filter game logs by stat thresholds, opponent, time, or home/away.

player: name, nickname, or id (same resolution as every other tool).
Required unless league_wide=True or team_wide=True.
league_wide: when True, ignore player and return per-player match
counts across the whole warehouse (answers "who had the most
50-point games this season").
team_wide: when True, ignore player and return per-team match
counts across the whole warehouse (answers "which team had the
most 50-point games this season"). Each matched game counts for
the team the player was on that night (first token of MATCHUP,
e.g. "LAL vs. BOS" -> "LAL"), so a mid-season trade attributes
each game to the team at game time, not the current team.
playoffs: when True, read silver_playoff_gamelogs instead of the
regular-season table.
min_points / min_rebounds / min_assists: per-game stat floors
(e.g. min_points=40 for 40-point games). min_pra: points + rebounds
+ assists floor. max_points / max_rebounds / max_assists: per-game
stat ceilings, exclusive (max_points=20 keeps 0-19 games -
"under 20"). triple_double / double_double: keep only games
with 10+ in 3 (or 2) of PTS/REB/AST/STL/BLK. opponent: team name or
abbreviation, e.g. "Knicks" or "NYK". month: name, number, or
YYYY-MM. start_date / end_date: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. home_away:
"home" or "away". season: 2025-26 only in the warehouse.
best_game: when True, ignore the limit and return only the single
highest-scoring game (answers "best game" / "career high" phrasing).
Returns matching games, most recent first, with the total match
count (rows beyond limit are counted, not returned). A player with
no rows in the chosen scope is an explicit ok:False error, never a
silent 0.
Warehouse only; 2025-26 only.

args_schema.description: Filter game logs by stat thresholds, opponent, time, or home/away.
args_schema.title: search_game_logs
